bank_transactions_integration_source_val.name: bank_transactions_integration_source_valid
bank_transactions_integration_source_val.value:
("bank_transactions"."source" = 'simulated' and "bank_transactions"."integration_id" is not null and "bank_transactions"."fio_integration_id" is null)
          or ("bank_transactions"."source" = 'fio' and "bank_transactions"."integration_id" is null and "bank_transactions"."fio_integration_id" is not null)

fio_integrations_token_state_valid.name: fio_integrations_token_state_valid
fio_integrations_token_state_valid.value:
("fio_integrations"."status" = 'disabled' and "fio_integrations"."token_ciphertext" is null and "fio_integrations"."token_iv" is null and "fio_integrations"."token_auth_tag" is null and "fio_integrations"."token_fingerprint" is null)
          or ("fio_integrations"."status" <> 'disabled' and "fio_integrations"."token_ciphertext" is not null and "fio_integrations"."token_iv" is not null and "fio_integrations"."token_auth_tag" is not null and "fio_integrations"."token_fingerprint" is not null)
